## Sewer Ooze (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
N Medium ooze  
**Init** -1; **Senses** blind, blindsight 60 ft., Perception +0  


**Defense**


**AC** 9, touch 9, flat-footed 9 (-1 Dex)  
**hp** 24 (2d8+8)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** -1, **Will** +0; +5 vs. entangle, entrap  
**DR** 5/slashing or piercing; **Immune** acid, disease, gaze attacks, ooze traits, visual spells and effects  
**Defensive Abilities** slick  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., swim 10 ft.  
**Melee** slam +2 (1d4+1 plus 1d4 acid)  
**Special Attacks** caustic wave  


**Statistics**


**Str** 13, **Dex** 8, **Con** 18, **Int** -, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 1  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 11 (16 vs. grapple, cannot be tripped)  
**Skills** Stealth -1 (+7 in sewers), Swim +9; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth in sewers  


**Ecology**


**Environment** urban and underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair or brigade (3-12)  
**Treasure** incidental  


**Special Abilities**


**Caustic Wave (Ex)** As a standard action once per day, a sewer ooze may expel sticky sludge in a 20 foot radius centered on itself. All creatures in the area take 1d6 points of acid damage and are entangled for 1d4+1 rounds. A successful DC 15 Reflex save halves the damage and negates the entangled condition. The save DC is Constitution based.  

**Slick (Ex)** A sewer ooze gains a +5 to its CMD against grapple attempts, and adds 5 to any Reflex saves against effects that would entangle, entrap or glue it.
